notes:
Foreword:
The purpose of this exercise within the ideonomical division "Phenomena" is to check the [validity, efficiency, sufficiency, and power] of the divisional list "208 Major Universally Investigable Dimensions of Scientific Phenomena" in the case of the specific chemical phenomenon 'adhesion'. How good is the list as a whole, and also how do its individual items fare?

Only items 1–67 are fully visible in the photograph; the remainder is outside the frame.
